name: ast-grep
description: Search code by syntax structure and return source locations, matched text and metavariable captures.

search.description: Find AST patterns in local source files without rewriting them.
search.progressive_guidance: Use for structural code questions rather than plain text search. Returned native ranges have zero-based line and column positions; metaVariables contains captured nodes.

pattern.description: ast-grep syntax pattern, e.g. console.log($$$ARGS). $NAME captures one node; $$$NAME captures several.

paths.description: Existing local paths; ~ expands to the owner home.

language.description: Optional native language name, e.g. TypeScript, JavaScript or Python. Omit to infer from file extensions.

progressive_guidance: Read-only, shell-free search. Respect hidden and ignore rules; do not follow recursive symlinks. Uses an empty configuration so workspace configuration cannot load custom grammars. Uses Leon-managed binaries with built-in execution and output limits. Large output fails explicitly rather than silently reporting an incomplete result as complete. Use operating_system_control.ripgrep for filename discovery and literal text search.
